cues: By about thirty two cells, a fluid filled cavity appears inside: the blastocoel.
The embryo is now a hollow ball, a blastula.
The heavy yolky macromeres crowd the bottom, so the cavity is pushed up into the animal half.
text: By about thirty two cells, a fluid filled cavity appears inside: the blastocoel. The embryo is now a hollow ball, a blastula. The heavy yolky macromeres crowd the bottom, so the cavity is pushed up into the animal half. It is eccentric.
